description: CERN-specific Firefly 12-channel optical transceiver for Versatile Link Plus system. Tx and Rx are separate physical TWI devices, each with a full lower-page map at the same style of addresses as the standard x12 variant (see firefly12.json) -- there is no shifted TX/RX base-address scheme.
uart_address_range: device_number = uart_address - 0x20 (a synthetic MCU ProgCom index, NOT the physical I2C/TWI address)
key_differences_from_standard: No CDR control registers/methods -- CDR is not adjustable through the standard addresses on this variant (cm_interface.device.firefly.FireflyTxCern/FireflyRxCern intentionally expose no disable_cdr()).
VENDOR_NAME and EEPROM_REV at the standard base addresses (0x98/0x6E) ARE valid on this variant, unlike the standard X12 Rev. 4 map where they are reserved.
Per-channel polarity/disable/amplitude/de-emphasis live at different addresses than the standard x12 map (see lower_page_registers below) -- do not reuse standard-x12 addresses for these fields.

A previous version of this file claimed shifted TX/RX register-space bases (0x30/0x40) and CERN-specific radiation-hardening/watchdog/SEU/test-mode control registers at 0x60-0x7F. A datasheet audit found no supporting register definitions for any of that in CERN Tables 22/37 and it has been removed -- treat any such claim as unverified unless re-confirmed against the manual.

TX_POLARITY.description: TX polarity invert mask, Table 29. Previously (incorrectly) documented at 0x48.

RX_DISABLE.description: RX channel disable mask, Table 43. Previously (incorrectly) documented at 0x42, which is actually the RX amplitude control.

RX_OUTPUT_AMP.description: Per-channel RX output amplitude, bytes 0x3E-43, Table 45. Previously (incorrectly) documented at 0x44, which is actually the RX de-emphasis control.

RX_DEEMPHASIS.description: Per-channel RX de-emphasis, bytes 0x44-49, Table 46. Previously (incorrectly) documented at 0x4A, which is reserved.

VENDOR_NAME.description: Vendor name ('Samtec Inc' or 'CERN'). Valid on this variant (unlike standard X12 Rev. 4, where this address is reserved).

TEMP_BIN_BASE.description: 22 temperature bins x 3 bytes (24-bit counters), bytes 128-193, Tables 36/53.

notes: Tx and Rx are separate physical TWI devices, each with a full lower-page map (like the standard x12 variant) -- not a single device with shifted TX/RX register-space bases.
Compatible with Versatile Link Plus optical system
Memory map derived from CERN_Back_End_x12_FireFly_User_Manual.pdf, Tables 22/37 (Tx/Rx lower-page maps) and cross-checked corrections in Tables 29/36/43/45/46/53
All multi-byte values are Big Endian
Int_L pin asserts on unmasked faults

No radiation-hardening, watchdog, SEU-counter, or test-mode control registers are confirmed to exist for this variant -- a previous version of this file described such registers at 0x60-0x7F with no supporting datasheet reference; treat any such capability as unverified unless independently re-confirmed.
